|strategy=By [mailto:webmaster@njkingdom.com Andrew Parks]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/youllfindimfullofsurprises.html</ref>

At first glance, you might say, "Hey, why would I play this card?" After all, although it gives the Light Side a chance to duel, it automatically starts you at a disadvantage, giving the Dark Side two destiny to your one. And although having [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] placed out of play might seem appealing versus a [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] deck, you can't play this card when that Objective is out (due to the Objective's card text).

So what's the point? Well, if you're willing to devote a few extra cards to your Mains deck, this card can certainly be an unwelcome surprise for the Dark Side. Most decks carry a [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] or three, so devoting a bit of your strategy to this card can usually be effective. And it is a 6 Destiny card, so it will always have that bit of usefulness. Now, play two or three of these cards in your deck, and you've got some of the high destiny you need to succeed with this card.

Also, pack Courage of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] to give you another destiny to even things out a bit with the old Dark Lord. And let's not forget [[Glancing Blow]], which allows you to cancel one of the Dark Side's duelling destiny draws or, if you play You'll Find I'm Full of Surprises during the weapons segment of a battle, you can use [[Glancing Blow]] to nail [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s power, knocking it to an unmodifiable zero, which means he won't even get the +2 power from holding his lightsaber granted by the Interrupt. Suddenly, [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s chances of winning have become quite slim, and it looks like he's going away for a very long time.

Having this sort of a side strategy not only lets you beat up [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]'s favorite sparring partner, but also gives you a plethora of cards to defend yourself during duels initiated by the Dark Side with such cards as [[Epic Duel]] or new cards like [[Darth Maul]].

Some new [[Tatooine]] cards that can help you win the day versus [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] include [[A Jedi's Focus]]: which lets you add the destiny of the top card of the Lost Pile to your total, [[A Jedi's Patience]]: which lets you redraw one of your bad duelling destiny draws, and most importantly, [[A Jedi's Resilience]], which allows you to cancel a duel AFTER you've lost it AND take the duelling card back into your hand!

But watch out for the new Dark Side card, [[Lightsaber Parry]], or your duel might suddenly become very expensive!
